_meta.description: Amazon Associates and FTC requirements checked against this site. 'status' is the site's compliance state as built. Every row links to the official source.

rules.requirement: State 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.' clearly and prominently on the site.
rules.site_implementation: Disclosure bar on every page and beside each affiliate link.

rules.requirement: Show prices and availability only if Amazon serves the link, or the data comes from Creators API / PA API.
rules.site_implementation: No Amazon prices are published. Flag F-02.

rules.requirement: Do not display Amazon customer reviews or star ratings unless obtained through Creators API / PA API.
rules.site_implementation: No star ratings or review counts are published. Flag F-02.

rules.requirement: Every Special Link must include the Associates ID (tag) as a URL parameter.
rules.site_implementation: User-supplied short links are used as given. The tag does not appear in the resolved URLs. Flag F-03.

rules.requirement: Do not use a link shortening service in a way that makes it unclear that the link goes to an Amazon Site.
rules.source_ref: Participation Requirements, Section 3(w); Commission Income Statement, Section 2(g)
rules.site_implementation: The links use link.amazon, Amazon's own short domain, and are labelled as Amazon links. Flag F-04.

rules.requirement: Do not include Amazon trademarks in domain names, subdomains or tags.
rules.site_implementation: Site domain is kanlerxz87-cyber.github.io/Zone4, which contains no Amazon mark.

rules.requirement: Do not buy paid search advertisements on keywords that include Amazon trademarks.
rules.source_ref: Commission Income Statement, Section 2(c); Participation Requirements, Section 3(f)
rules.site_implementation: No paid advertising is connected to this site.

rules.requirement: Do not assign sub-tags to individual end users.
rules.site_implementation: No per-user tracking or sub-tags are used.

rules.requirement: Do not offer incentives for using Special Links, and do not place Special Links in customer reviews or Amazon content.
rules.site_implementation: No incentives or rewards are offered; no links are placed on Amazon.

rules.requirement: Do not display price-comparison data without showing both the lowest new and the lowest used price on Amazon.
rules.site_implementation: No prices are displayed, so no comparison is shown.

rules.requirement: Do not collect, use or store product listings, descriptions or prices beyond the license; do not use data mining or robots.
rules.source_ref: Amazon Conditions of Use, 'License and Access'
rules.site_implementation: Verification read product pages with an automated retrieval tool. Only identifiers and a few spec fields are kept. Flag F-11.

rules.requirement: Do not use AI-generated content from Amazon Services to develop or improve large language or machine learning models.
rules.source_ref: Amazon Conditions of Use, 'License and Access'
rules.site_implementation: Planned AI content automation is NOT built. Flag F-12.

rules.requirement: Disclose a material connection clearly, placed with the endorsement, in simple language that is hard to miss.
rules.source_ref: FTC Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers, 'How to Disclose'
rules.site_implementation: The Associates disclosure sentence is shown on every page, including next to each affiliate link.

rules.requirement: Link-level disclosure must be clear and conspicuous and placed near each affiliate link, not hidden on another page.
rules.source_ref: Associates Central help: 'Why do I have to identify myself as an Associate?'
rules.site_implementation: The disclosure sentence appears directly under each 'Open Amazon link' button, in the same card or row.

rules.requirement: Commission income is paid on Qualifying Revenue, which excludes shipping, gift-wrap, handling, taxes, service charges, credits, rebates, card fees and bad debt.
rules.site_implementation: Applies to any future earnings model. No earnings are calculated, because the category rate is unverified (F-01).

rules.requirement: A Qualifying Purchase requires a Special Link click, a 24-hour session and an order within 89 days of the click (for cart purchases), and excludes search-engine-displayed and redirecting links.
rules.site_implementation: Links are direct, with no redirect or intermediate page. Search-engine display is not controlled by this site.

rules.requirement: Do not use Special Links or Program Content to develop machine learning models or related technology without express prior written approval.
rules.source_ref: Participation Requirements, Section 5; IP License Sections 1 and 2(e)
rules.site_implementation: No model training or AI analysis is run on Amazon data. AI automation is not built. Flag F-17.

rules.requirement: An autonomous agent that accesses Program Content must identify itself (user agent 'Agent/[agent name]'), must not conceal or mimic humans, and must not circumvent blocking measures.
rules.site_implementation: No agent accesses Program Content. Flag F-18.

rules.requirement: Use Program Content only to promote Amazon products, and link each use only to the relevant Amazon page.
rules.source_ref: Participation Requirements, Section 3(z); IP License Sections 1 and 2(c)(iii)
rules.site_implementation: Every product link goes to an Amazon product page. Comparisons with non-Amazon products are not built. Flag F-19.

rules.requirement: Where Product Advertising Content consisting of text is displayed, show Amazon's disclaimer that the content comes from Amazon.
rules.site_implementation: Not yet shown. Whether listing text counts as Product Advertising Content is open. Flag F-20.
